description: This file defines the RegressionMetrics class used for evaluating regression models in Apache Spark's MLlib. It computes various regression metrics such as explained variance, mean absolute error, mean squared error, root mean squared error, and R-squared, based on prediction and observation data.

classes.name: RegressionMetrics
classes.description: A class for evaluating regression models, providing metrics like explained variance, MAE, MSE, RMSE, and R-squared based on prediction and observation data.

methods.name: explainedVariance
methods.description: Calculates the variance explained by the regression model.

methods.name: meanAbsoluteError
methods.description: Calculates the mean absolute error of the predictions.

methods.name: meanSquaredError
methods.description: Calculates the mean squared error of the predictions.

methods.name: rootMeanSquaredError
methods.description: Calculates the root mean squared error of the predictions.

methods.name: r2
methods.description: Calculates the R-squared coefficient of determination.
